# Self-Publishing School

> Self-Publishing School teaches aspiring authors how to write, publish, and sell nonfiction books through masterclasses, guides, and proven publishing frameworks.

Founded by Chandler Bolt, Self-Publishing School provides free and paid resources for nonfiction authors looking to self-publish. The platform combines educational content with lead magnets and practical templates to help authors navigate the publishing process.

## Key Topics

- self-publishing
- nonfiction book writing

- Chandler Bolt

## Free Learning Resources

- [Write A Nonfiction Book In Class | Free Masterclass](https://learn.self-publishingschool.com/sps-eg-bab-write-your-book-in-class-author-masterclass-65): Free nonfiction book writing masterclass with Chandler Bolt teaching structure and techniques for aspiring authors.

## Lead Magnets & Guides

- [Get Your Free Copy of Published.](https://self-publishingschool.com/published): Free lead magnet book offering publishing shortcuts and templates from Self Publishing School.
